full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_zh: 算力来源、能耗、端侧边界、故障降级
full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_en: Compute source, energy, edge boundary and degraded mode

full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_zh: 数据清单、许可、最小化、删除与贡献署名
full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_en: Register, licence, minimisation, deletion and attribution

full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_zh: 能力边界、偏差、拒答、红队与人工接管
full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_en: Capability limits, bias, refusal, red-team and human takeover

full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_zh: 版本、依赖、接口、可移植部署与陌生团队接管
full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_en: Version, dependencies, interfaces, portable deployment and unfamiliar-team takeover

full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_zh: 问题所有者、非 AI 基线、排班、SLA 与无损退出
full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_en: Problem owner, non-AI baseline, roster, SLA and harmless exit

full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_zh: 验收、成本区间、采购状态、培训、差异条件与复原
full_stack_layers.minimum_evidence_en: Acceptance, cost range, procurement state, training, changed conditions and restoration

daily_life_journey.task_zh: 通勤、找服务、完成一项真实工作任务
daily_life_journey.task_en: Commute, find service and complete a real work task
daily_life_journey.public_baseline_zh: 普通路线与人工窗口始终可用
daily_life_journey.public_baseline_en: Ordinary route and staffed window remain available

daily_life_journey.task_zh: 用餐、办事、购物与无障碍停留
daily_life_journey.task_en: Eat, access services, shop and stay accessibly
daily_life_journey.public_baseline_zh: 不强制注册，不以消费换取公共服务
daily_life_journey.public_baseline_en: No mandatory sign-up or paywall for public service

daily_life_journey.task_zh: 理解铁路文化、参加首用培训、纠正 AI
daily_life_journey.task_en: Learn railway culture, join first-use training and correct AI
daily_life_journey.public_baseline_zh: 史实和高影响内容由人终审
daily_life_journey.public_baseline_en: Humans final-review history and high-impact content

daily_life_journey.task_zh: 公共客厅交流、夜间活动与安全返程
daily_life_journey.task_en: Meet in the commons, attend an evening event and return safely
daily_life_journey.public_baseline_zh: 免费停留、照明、人工求助与退出成立
daily_life_journey.public_baseline_en: Free stay, lighting, human help and exit remain available

protocol.name_zh: 京张 AI 城市采用与治理协议
protocol.release_cycle_zh: 每年公开问题单、版本变更、失败记录与通过 G4 的双语复用包；城市间只交换经授权和脱敏的结构，不交换个人数据。
protocol.release_cycle_en: Annually publish problem orders, version changes, failures and bilingual reuse packs that pass G4; cities exchange authorised, de-identified structures, not personal data.
protocol.success_rule_zh: 不以城市徽标数量或活动声量计成功，只以可核验复用、可退出性和公开失败质量计。
protocol.success_rule_en: Success is not city-logo count or event reach; it is verified reuse, reversibility and the quality of open failure records.

claim_boundary_zh: 本文件是方案自拟的任务响应与开放协议草案，不代表官方采纳、合作承诺、采购、投资或实施。
claim_boundary_en: This is a proposal-authored task response and open-protocol draft, not official adoption, partnership, procurement, funding or implementation.
